purpose: Post-hoc method development prompted by candidate-count and question-type subgroup instability: compare a frozen candidate-size-aware multi-axis Mondrian calibration rule with the existing global split-conformal rule on identical outer evaluation cases.

development_boundary.reason: The hierarchy was specified after the four-dataset observable-subgroup audit exposed instability for the 2WikiMultiHopQA lt_20 candidate-count bucket and bridge_comparison question type.
development_boundary.required_next_confirmation: Only if every frozen development adoption check passes may the method be frozen and evaluated once on untouched MuSiQue data.

frozen_model_protocol.sufficiency_head: One global class-balanced deterministic IRLS head is fitted on each train split.

multi_axis_mondrian_calibration.calibration_unit: Maximum incomplete-variant sufficiency score within each calibration case family.
multi_axis_mondrian_calibration.declaration_rule: Declare complete only when the variant score is strictly greater than the selected threshold.

execution_policy.if_all_checks_pass: Freeze the developed method and run one independent confirmation on untouched MuSiQue data.
execution_policy.if_any_check_fails: Retain the negative result, do not adopt the method, and do not download or inspect MuSiQue for this method-selection cycle.

theoretical_scope.groupwise_statement: A finite-sample groupwise marginal statement requires exchangeability within the exact calibration group whose threshold is used.
theoretical_scope.fallback_statement: A fallback threshold does not create a conditional guarantee for a more specific subgroup that lacked calibration support.

gate_policy: This post-hoc development experiment cannot change Gate 2 from NO-GO/SHADOW and cannot authorize CANARY or DEFAULT.
